name: rafflesia_flower
description: Rafflesia arnoldii corpse flower in full bloom on the forest floor, low 3/4 view from above: five thick fleshy brick red-brown #a8402a lobes with raised cream #efe0c8 warts, a raised central cup (diaphragm) with a dark #3a1410 opening and a ring of pale spikes. No stem, no leaves, no flies. Anchor centre, ~620x300 (x -310..310, y -150..150).
